body:
Closes #709

Kind: off unless set.

`LAMP_SCHEDULE_TOOLS=on` exposes six Schedule tools in Voice and enables their Actions routes; both roles require the exact value `on`. `LAMP_SCHEDULE_SPEAK=on` separately enables Voice's isolated reminder consumer, with `LAMP_SCHEDULE_DELIVERY_DIR` provisioned as private persistent state. No deployment file changes.

Default-off proof: fresh `1337e7e1d8` baseline and implementation source copies passed **72 cases / 144 exact stdout comparisons**, without normalization, across two profiles and all 36 combinations of absent/non-enabling switch values. The boundary is public catalogs, declarations, existing route lists and ordinary Written requests; functional tests separately exercise real routes. All 34 local package manifests resolve inside each copy. [Raw comparisons, helper sources and copy audit](https://github.com/autonomous-ai/lampOS/blob/506e9e519883191dda8db565e2e3e5283c635331/lampOS/docs/verification/schedule-voice-qualification-20261015/standalone-1337/README.md).

Verification: [task source and historical evidence](https://github.com/autonomous-ai/lampOS/blob/d794cf2aca8fd5a7891af6363f2155e9fd3091fe/lampOS/docs/verification/schedule-voice-host-20261014/README.md), [final focused checks](https://github.com/autonomous-ai/lampOS/blob/d794cf2aca8fd5a7891af6363f2155e9fd3091fe/lampOS/docs/verification/schedule-voice-host-20261014/integration-1337/README.md), and [terminal qualification index](https://github.com/autonomous-ai/lampOS/blob/506e9e519883191dda8db565e2e3e5283c635331/lampOS/docs/verification/schedule-voice-qualification-20261015/README.md). Earlier failed runs retain their actual source IDs and outcomes.

Gate on Third's Intel i7-10700K x86_64 Mac, macOS 26.6.2 / Darwin 25.6.0, 64 GiB RAM, Rust/Cargo 1.96.0, from `lampOS/`:

- `cargo fmt --all --check` — passed.
- `cargo clippy --offline --locked -p lamp-actions -p lamp-schedule -p lamp-voice -p lamp-voice-eval -p lamp-memory --all-targets -- -D warnings` — passed.
- Seven documented Voice filters — **136 test executions / 0 failed / 2 ignored**. The Days exclusion test appears in two filters; these are executions, not unique tests. Exact commands are retained in the focused record.
- `cargo build --offline --locked --workspace` — passed.
- `cargo test --offline --locked -p lamp-actions -p lamp-schedule -p lamp-voice -p lamp-voice-eval -p lamp-memory --no-fail-fast -- --test-threads=1` — **FAILED: 1,764 passed / 1 failed / 13 ignored**, 77 harnesses, exit 101, 2,013.072357316 seconds.
- Independent source copy: workspace/helper builds passed, **435 test executions / 0 failed / 7 ignored**, plus all 144 off-switch comparisons.
- Two existing host timing probes run explicitly once each after local builds/tests ended: **2 / 0 / 0**, 606 raw poll samples. Maximum parent poll 0.325789 ms; maximum transport poll 0.063886 ms, below the 2 ms reference. [Boundaries and samples](https://github.com/autonomous-ai/lampOS/blob/506e9e519883191dda8db565e2e3e5283c635331/lampOS/docs/verification/schedule-voice-qualification-20261015/timing-1337/README.md) exclude startup, storage, providers, audio and lamp behavior; neither probe asserts a timing threshold.

The sole complete-gate failure is unchanged `coordinator::motor::tests::crash_and_stalled_control_never_allow_replacement_or_false_cleanup`. It timed out waiting for `OptionalMotor::reaped` at `motor/tests.rs:645` through the line-441 wait assertion. The failed crash/hang iteration was not recorded; no cause is inferred. **The exact same compiled test passed once alone: 1 / 0 / 0**, 5.000996141 seconds. Its source matches integration; its binary SHA-256 was identical before the full run and before/after isolation. [Both raw runs and identities](https://github.com/autonomous-ai/lampOS/blob/506e9e519883191dda8db565e2e3e5283c635331/lampOS/docs/verification/schedule-voice-qualification-20261015/full-host-1337/README.md) are retained. This meets [First's explicit untouched-test handoff condition](https://github.com/autonomous-ai/lampOS/issues/709#issuecomment-6176285386), tracked by Fourth in #739. **The complete host gate remains failed.** No fixture, assertion or deadline was changed for this result.

Native ARM64 run [38633124293](https://github.com/autonomous-ai/lampOS/actions/runs/38633124293) passed on exact head `d794cf2aca8fd5a7891af6363f2155e9fd3091fe`: **4,365 passed / 0 failed / 34 ignored**, 282 harnesses, GitHub Ubuntu 22.04 ARM64, Rust 1.96.0. Commands: `cargo build --locked --release --workspace --bins --examples`, then `cargo test --locked --release --workspace -- --test-threads=1`. Artifact: `lampos-arm64-d794cf2aca8fd5a7891af6363f2155e9fd3091fe`. [Terminal output and every binary checksum](https://github.com/autonomous-ai/lampOS/blob/506e9e519883191dda8db565e2e3e5283c635331/lampOS/docs/verification/schedule-voice-qualification-20261015/native-d794cf/README.md). Four inherited Controls/Expression `replay_cost` filename warnings remain recorded; no warning-free workspace claim is made.

| Installable Task 31 binary | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| `lamp-actions` | `33a16f446b32697b608d6ab5307ebd4917b32265635800266240b3be541dc6cb` |
| `lamp-schedule` | `12598462e7005ecbef98838dde2a83cf9c6e557de204b3a1e1d0749c90290664` |
| `lamp-voice` | `a29fcf3986cc58cd52c9142a39a280d4ae2dce62d41d8c7c999b9760a448d19f` |

The consumer durably correlates `(store_id, id, delivery)`, revalidates bounded offers, and waits for local silence, current privacy/readiness and owed camera/Second Look work. Unknown, Busy and Quiet all permit a requested reminder at that silence, as settled in the issue. Ack follows successful provider completion and final retirement of every audio generation. Interrupted or uncertain attempts remain pending without automatic re-speech. A due request cannot execute a tool or enter automatic Memory journalling, including Days mode. Schedule mutation failures and uncertain replies remain truthful.

Integration advanced during qualification from this task's `1337e7e1d8` base to `f2261ec48`. The incoming Update crate, lamp-owned unit snapshot and Memory doc change do not change affected-package/Bus/Msgs source. [Read-only integration review and clean merge preview](https://github.com/autonomous-ai/lampOS/blob/506e9e519883191dda8db565e2e3e5283c635331/lampOS/docs/verification/schedule-voice-qualification-20261015/integration-1337/incoming-update-review.md) found no new reminder conflict. The qualified artifact does not include or qualify the incoming Update crate or combined tree. **Install only Actions, Schedule and Voice; preserve installed Update and current lamp-owned unit settings, especially `LAMP_MEMORY_DAYS=on`.** Repoint executable paths and apply Schedule drop-ins; do not copy the older task-head Voice service over the current unit. Reminder-owned states and transcripts remain visible to Update's observational quiet gate.

[First's lamp qualification](https://github.com/autonomous-ai/lampOS/blob/d794cf2aca8fd5a7891af6363f2155e9fd3091fe/lampOS/docs/schedule.md#task-31-lamp-qualification) gives the off-state minute, exact service settings and disable sequence, scheduling checks and seven spoken cases. Most likely wrong on the lamp: provider schema/wording, local-silence timing in a busy office, ALSA final retirement, flash stalls and the consumer's RR20-to-Other/nice-19 transition. No lamp or real provider was accessed; host process durations and IPC probes are not acoustic or lamp latency.
